subject.title: fix(desktop): notifications use native macOS and Windows services

question: Should this desktop app adopt macOS 13 as its minimum and temporarily trust the pinned contributor fork, or must the change preserve the current support floor and wait for an upstream dependency revision?
rationale: The patch cannot mechanically decide the supported macOS upgrade contract or whether a contributor-controlled native-code dependency is acceptable for release artifacts.

options.title: Preserve support and upstream
options.body: Keep the existing macOS support floor with a gated fallback and use an audited upstream revision before release.

options.title: Approve the new boundary
options.body: Explicitly adopt macOS 13 and the temporary fork, with updater gating, a reviewed fork diff, and a dated upstream-exit plan.

options.title: Pause for upstream
options.body: Hold this PR until the required upstream notification changes land and can be pinned directly.

recommendation.title: Preserve support and upstream
recommendation.body: Keep the existing macOS support floor with a gated fallback and use an audited upstream revision before release.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person with desktop product direction and the current implementation choice.
